page.layout: One page of table: running head at top, title "MAIUS" beneath it, then one table of five columns (golden number, day of month, letter, Roman date, days collected in common year | leap year). Page number at top right. Catchword "Ju-" at bottom right.

main_text.head: MAIUS.
main_text.l: Aurei num. | Dies mensis | Litera | | Dies collecti in anno communi | bissextili

page.notes: Table column headings as printed: "Aurei num.", "Dies mensis", "Litera", (unlabelled Roman-date column), "Dies collecti in anno communi" and "bissextili".
